transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. Let's go through each area: technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — please report your final operating requirements. I'll need to hear from all four before I can sign off on the binding production approval. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding before we proceed. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras operating from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure it's reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval, since the current draft package references three cameras but doesn't specify the wired/fixed constraint.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights issue before we proceed to final approval. I received the countersigned performance license this morning, and it permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package, which permits the recording to be reused in the festival archive. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, but it needs to be reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval — the archive reuse provision must be removed and the recording must be designated broadcast-only.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical talent issue before we proceed to final approval. I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday, and the rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email, but it is not yet reflected in the production schedule. The 3:00 PM soundcheck constraint needs to be added to the schedule, and the sponsor product display on stage directly conflicts with the rider — it must be removed from the stage before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical accessibility issue before we proceed to final approval. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet. The Booth B assignment needs to be reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A5
